L163:     `    + Correct minor mistakes in code comments in event_groups.c, include/queue.h,
L164:           and include/task.h. We thank @wirelinker for their contribution.
L165:         + Add Arm China STAR-MC3 port support. We thank @cpussw01 for their
L166:           contribution.
L167:         + Add Memory Protection Unit (MPU) support to the ARM Cortex-R82 port. We
L168:           thank @AhmedIsmail02 for their contribution.
L169:         + Add ARM Cortex-M52 port support for GCC and IAR compilers. We thank
L170:           @Armchina_JidongMei for their contribution.
L171:         + Add ARM Cortex-R82 non-MPU port for ARMv8-R AArch64 with SMP support. We
L172:           thank @AhmedIsmail02 for their contribution.
L173:         + Add Floating Point Unit (FPU) context save support to the RISC-V port.
L174:           We thank @cubidesj for their contribution.
L175:         + Add Vector context save support to the RISC-V port. We thank @cubidesj
L176:           for their contribution.
L177:         + Add xPortIsInsideInterrupt API to the RP2040 port to match other ARM
L178:           ports. We thank @graham-sanderson for their contribution.
L179:         + Add catch up behavior documentation to xTaskDelayUntil API to explain
L180:           frequency breaks when catching up for past events.
L181:         + Add asserts to check for stack overflow at task creation time.
L182:         + Add assert to check for overflow in xStreamBufferSendFromISR API.
L183:         + Add assert to check for overflow of recursive mutex counter. We thank
L184:           @InnerSteff for their contribution.
L185:         + Add CFI frame unwind information in portable/IAR/RXv2/port_asm.s to
L186:           enable debugger callstack display beyond __interrupt_27. We thank
L187:           @bernd-edlinger for their contribution.
L188:         + Update xTaskDelayUntil to be the preferred delay function in the
L189:           FreeRTOSConfig.h template.
L190:         + Update RISC-V port to use saved mstatus for FPU/VPU state determination
L191:           instead of re-reading after writes, addressing specification-compliant
L192:           implementations where FS field may change to Dirty.
L193:         + Update RISC-V port to refine vector context layout on stack for proper
L194:           register ordering. We thank @Saiiijchan for their contribution.
L195:         + Update RISC-V port to refine FPU register context offset calculation. We
L196:           thank @Saiiijchan for their contribution.
L197:         + Update RISC-V port to use UBaseType_t for ullMachineTimerCompareRegisterBase
L198:           to resolve warnings on 32-bit platforms.
L199:         + Update FreeRTOS MPU to remove the assertion and runtime check enforcing
L200:           matching between configTOTAL_MPU_REGIONS and physical MPU regions,
L201:           allowing applications to manage a subset of available regions. We thank
L202:           @ErickReyesR for their contribution.
L203:         + Update ARM_CRx_No_GIC port to set Data endianness bit in SPSR register
L204:           for big-endian compilation. We thank @maximdeclercq00 for their
L205:           contribution.
L206:         + Update Win32 port to guard timeapi.h include for MinGW compatibility and
L207:           add compiler-specific headers for cross-compiler support. We thank
L208:           @nordync for their contribution.
L209:         + Update Win32 port to move Windows headers to port.c to prevent inclusion
L210:           of windows.h in all header files and avoid macro conflicts. We thank
L211:           @creiter64 for their contribution.
L212:         + Update POSIX port to delete thread key on process exit instead of in
L213:           xPortStartScheduler to ensure proper cleanup of thread-specific memory.
L214:         + Update POSIX port to fix race condition in vPortEndScheduler by moving
L215:           scheduler thread signal after FreeRTOS thread check. We thank
L216:           @arctic-alpaca for their contribution.
L217:         + Update RP2040 port to fix use of deprecated volatile semantics for C++20
L218:           compatibility. We thank @mathiasgredal for their contribution.
L219:         + Update RP2040 port to propagate PICO_SDK_VERSION_* to parent scope in
L220:           CMake. We thank @shengtai25 for their contribution.
L221:         + Update RP2040 port to remove unused code and preprocessor directives. We
L222:           thank @pascalr for their contribution.
L223:         + Update RL78 port to fix incorrect register image for pvParameters in FAR
L224:           data model for IAR compiler. We thank @sauleThsQuin for their
L225:           contribution.
L226:         + Update RL78 port to fix compilation failure on portasm.s file due to
L227:           indentation on ASM macro. We thank @5iBri for their contribution.
L228:         + Update ARM_CRx_MPU port to add LLVM assembler compatibility by
L229:           explicitly specifying section flags. We thank @malsyned for their
L230:           contribution.
L231:         + Update Cortex-M ports to rename ulStackFrameSize to
L232:           ulHardwareSavedExceptionFrameSize for improved readability. We thank
L233:           @AhmedIsmail02 for their contribution.
L234:         + Update MPLAB PIC32MZ-EF port to add assert to catch register overflow.
L235:           We thank @mrluzeiro for their contribution.
L236:         + Update comments related to taskYIELD in queue.h. We thank @Saiiijchan
L237:           for their contribution.
L238:         + Fix priority disinheritance in vTaskPriorityDisinheritAfterTimeout to
L239:           reset the correct priority when the task disinheriting timeout was the
L240:           only task at that priority.
L241:         + Fix event groups to remove direct mapping of xEventGroupClearBitsFromISR
L242:           and xEventGroupSetBitsFromISR to xTimerPendFunctionCallFromISR,
L243:           resolving redefinition warnings. We thank @AhmedIsmail02 for their
L244:           contribution.
L245:         + Fix datatype of queue item length macros from uint8_t to UBaseType_t to
L246:           match API parameter types.
L247:         + Fix possible NULL pointer dereference after configASSERT() calls in
L248:           queue.c and stream_buffer.c. We thank @Florian.LaRoche for their
L249:           contribution.
L250:         + Fix Win32 port to prevent SetWaitableTimer() call from being ignored
L251:           when configASSERT expands to nothing. We thank @kim-schwaner for their
L252:           contribution.
L253:         + Fix compiler warnings from gcc -Wconversion. We thank @Florian.LaRoche
L254:           for their contribution.
L255:         + Fix compiler warning about gcc -Wwrite-strings in POSIX port. We thank
L256:           @Florian.LaRoche for their contribution.
L257:         + Fix set but unused variable warning in pxPortInitialiseStack. We thank
L258:           @razrbro for their contribution.
L259:         + Fix missing include to resolve compile error. We thank @mike919192 for
L260:           their contribution.
L261:         + Fix missing cast to BaseType_t.
L262:         + Fix cast in stack allocation for task creation for negative
L263:           portSTACK_GROWTH. We thank @sidharthseela for their contribution.
L264:         + Fix missing macro guards in task.h to prevent unintended API access. We
L265:           thank @SoniHarsh1 for their contribution.
L266:         + Fix CMake build for GCC_ARM_CRx_MPU by adding to mpu_wrappers patterns.
L267:           We thank @malsyned for their contribution.
L268:         + Fix initialization of size_t-type variable by changing macro from
L269:           portMAX_DELAY to SIZE_MAX. We thank @duyicheng741 for their
L270:           contribution.
L271:         + Define configENABLE_PAC and configENABLE_BTI before including portable.h
L272:           to prevent "used before definition" warnings.
L273:         + Remove stray semicolon from gcc-ARM_CRx_MPU port.c. We thank
L274:           @Florian.LaRoche for their contribution.
